title: 1816 Prairie's south flank window, upper storey only, as photographed
items: The south flank of 1816 Prairie now has one window, on the upper storey under its carved, crested hood, with plain brick below it down to the stone base, as the Chicagology photograph shows. The build had a window on each storey there.
That window is narrower and set lower, measured off the photograph: about 0.75 m wide, from 6.5 to 9.0 m above the ground.
